### `server info`

Get initialization info for a connected server.

```bash theme={"theme":"

css-variables"}
mcpjam server info --url https://your-server.com/mcp --access-token $TOKEN
```

Returns the server's `serverI

nfo` (name, version) and `capabilities` from the MCP initialize response.
